task: An investor runs a monthly SIP for 15 years (180 instalments) with a 10% annual step-up: the instalment is Rs 10,000 per month in year 1, Rs 11,000 in year 2, Rs 12,100 in year 3, and so on (multiply by 1.10 each year, no rounding). Each instalment is invested at the START of its month. The fund earns 12% a year compounded monthly, i.e. 1% per month, so an instalment invested at the start of month m (m = 1..180) is multiplied by 1.01^(181 - m) by the end of month 180. Compute, rounded to the nearest rupee: total_invested; future_value (value at the end of month 180); wealth_gained (future_value - total_invested); fv_without_stepup (future value if Rs 10,000 were invested every month with no step-up, same rules). RESULT keys: total_invested, future_value, wealth_gained, fv_without_stepup.

attempts.thought: To compute the total invested amount, I will sum the monthly SIP contributions over 15 years, considering the annual step-up of 10%. For the future value, I will calculate the compounded value of each installment based on when it was invested, using the formula for compound interest. I will also compute the future value without the step-up by investing a constant amount of Rs 10,000 each month. I will assert that the total invested matches the sum of the step-up contributions and that the future value calculations are consistent across both methods.
attempts.code:
total_invested = 0
future_value = 0.0
fv_without_stepup = 0.0
monthly_rate = 0.01
months = 180
step_up_rate = 1.10
initial_investment = 10000

for year in range(15):
    monthly_investment = initial_investment * (step_up_rate ** year)
    for month in range(12):
        month_index = year * 12 + month + 1  # 1-based index for months
        total_invested += monthly_investment
        future_value += monthly_investment * (1 + monthly_rate) ** (months - month_index + 1)

# Future value without step-up
for month in range(1, months + 1):
    fv_without_stepup += initial_investment * (1 + monthly_rate) ** (months - month)

RESULT = {
    'total_invested': round(total_invested),
    'future_value': round(future_value),
    'wealth_gained': round(future_value - total_invested),
    'fv_without_stepup': round(fv_without_stepup)
}

# Assertions to check correctness
assert total_invested == sum(initial_investment * (step_up_rate ** year) * 12 for year in range(15)), f"Total invested mismatch: {total_invested} != {sum(initial_investment * (step_up_rate ** year) * 12 for year in range(15))}"
assert abs(future_value - sum(initial_investment * (1 + monthly_rate) ** (months - (year * 12 + month + 1)) for year in range(15) for month in range(12))) < 1e-6, f"Future value mismatch: {future_value} != {sum(initial_investment * (1 + monthly_rate) ** (months - (year * 12 + month + 1)) for year in range(15) for month in range(12))}"
